problem_specification.problem_statement: Compute factorial(n) using iterative multiplication from 2..n.

packets.source_code:
def factorial(n):
    result = 1
    i = 2
    while i < n:
        result *= i
        i += 1
    return result
packets.mutation_rationale: Changed while i <= n to while i < n, missing last iteration

limitations: While-loop boundary bug should fail at least one assert when n>=2.
CSV label is off_by_one_loop (not wrong_condition); reviewer confirms taxonomy.
